ball.en: The ball rolled across the field and stopped near the fence.
ball.zh: 球滾過球場，最後停在圍欄附近。

ban.en: The city plans to ban smoking in several public areas.
ban.zh: 這座城市計畫禁止在數個公共區域吸菸。

banana.en: She packed a banana and some crackers for the trip.
banana.zh: 她為旅程帶了一根香蕉和一些餅乾。

band.en: The school band practiced every afternoon before the concert.
band.zh: 校樂隊在音樂會前每天午後練習。

bank.en: He went to the bank to deposit some money.

bar.en: The chart uses each bar to represent one category.
bar.zh: 這張圖表用每一根長條代表一個類別。

bare.en: The tree stood bare after all its leaves had fallen.
bare.zh: 樹葉全落後，那棵樹變得光禿禿的。

bargain.en: The jacket was a bargain because it was heavily discounted.
bargain.zh: 那件外套因為大幅折扣，所以很划算。

base.en: The statue stands on a wide stone base.
base.zh: 這座雕像立在寬大的石座上。

baseball.en: We played baseball after school until the sun went down.
baseball.zh: 我們放學後打棒球直到太陽下山。

basic.en: Students should understand the basic rules before starting the activity.
basic.zh: 學生在開始活動前應先了解基本規則。

basically.en: The two plans are basically the same except for the price.
basically.zh: 除了價格之外，這兩個方案基本上相同。

basis.en: The team meets on a weekly basis to review progress.
basis.zh: 團隊每週固定開會檢視進度。

basket.en: She placed the fresh vegetables in a large basket.
basket.zh: 她把新鮮蔬菜放進一個大籃子裡。

basketball.en: Our basketball team practices three times a week after school.
basketball.zh: 我們的籃球隊每週放學後練習三次。

bath.en: A warm bath helped him relax after the long hike.
bath.zh: 長途健行後，洗個熱水澡讓他放鬆下來。

bathroom.en: The bathroom is located beside the stairs on the second floor.

battle.en: The history class discussed an important battle from the nineteenth century.
battle.zh: 歷史課討論了十九世紀的一場重要戰役。

beach.en: We collected plastic waste while walking along the beach.
beach.zh: 我們沿著海灘散步時撿拾塑膠垃圾。

bean.en: The class planted each bean in a small paper cup.
bean.zh: 全班把每顆豆子種在小紙杯裡。

bear.en: A bear was seen near the mountain trail yesterday morning.
bear.zh: 昨天早上有人在山徑附近看到一隻熊。

beat.en: The team managed to beat its strongest opponent in the final.
beat.zh: 這支隊伍成功在決賽中擊敗最強的對手。

beautiful.en: The mountain looked beautiful under the clear morning sky.
beautiful.zh: 在晴朗的晨空下，那座山看起來很美。

beauty.en: The beauty of the lake attracts many visitors every year.
beauty.zh: 這座湖的美景每年吸引許多遊客。

because.en: We stayed indoors because the rain became extremely heavy.
because.zh: 因為雨勢變得很大，我們待在室內。

become.en: With regular practice, difficult tasks can become much easier.
become.zh: 透過規律練習，困難的任務會變得容易許多。

bed.en: He went to bed early before the important exam.
bed.zh: 重要考試前，他很早就上床睡覺。

bedroom.en: Her bedroom has a desk beside the window.
bedroom.zh: 她的臥室窗邊有一張書桌。

bee.en: A bee landed on the flower beside the garden path.
bee.zh: 一隻蜜蜂停在花園小徑旁的花朵上。

beef.en: The restaurant serves noodles with beef and fresh vegetables.
beef.zh: 這家餐廳供應牛肉和新鮮蔬菜麵。

before.en: Please review the instructions before you begin the experiment.
before.zh: 開始實驗前請先複習操作說明。

begin.en: The meeting will begin at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
begin.zh: 會議將在明天上午十點開始。

beginning.en: The beginning of the story introduces the main characters clearly.
beginning.zh: 故事開頭清楚介紹了主要角色。

behavior.en: The teacher noticed a change in his classroom behavior.
behavior.zh: 老師注意到他在課堂行為上的改變。

behind.en: The bicycle was parked behind the library building.
behind.zh: 腳踏車停在圖書館建築後方。

belief.en: Her belief in teamwork helped the group stay united.
belief.zh: 她對團隊合作的信念幫助小組保持團結。

believe.en: I believe careful preparation can reduce stress before presentations.
believe.zh: 我相信充分準備能減少報告前的壓力。

bell.en: The bell rang just as the teacher finished speaking.
bell.zh: 老師剛講完時鐘聲正好響起。

belong.en: These books belong to the school library, not the classroom.
belong.zh: 這些書屬於學校圖書館，不是教室的。

below.en: Please write your answer in the space below the question.
below.zh: 請把答案寫在題目下方的空格中。

belt.en: He fastened his seat belt before the car started moving.
belt.zh: 車子開始移動前，他先繫好安全帶。

bench.en: We sat on a bench and watched people pass by.
bench.zh: 我們坐在長椅上看著人們經過。

bend.en: Do not bend the card because the chip may be damaged.
bend.zh: 不要彎折卡片，因為晶片可能會損壞。

beneath.en: A small storage room is located beneath the main staircase.
beneath.zh: 主樓梯下方有一間小儲藏室。

beside.en: She placed her notebook beside the computer before class began.
beside.zh: 上課前，她把筆記本放在電腦旁。

besides.en: Besides English, he is also studying Japanese this semester.
besides.zh: 除了英文之外，他這學期也在學日文。

best.en: The best solution is usually the one supported by clear evidence.
best.zh: 最好的解決方法通常是有明確證據支持的那一個。

better.en: You will understand the article better after learning these key words.
better.zh: 學會這些關鍵單字後，你會更理解這篇文章。

between.en: There is a clear difference between the two research methods.
between.zh: 這兩種研究方法之間有明顯差異。

beyond.en: The problem goes beyond money and involves public safety as well.
beyond.zh: 這個問題不只涉及金錢，也牽涉公共安全。

bicycle.en: She rides her bicycle to school on sunny days.
bicycle.zh: 天氣晴朗時，她會騎腳踏車上學。

big.en: A big decision should be made only after careful discussion.
big.zh: 重大決定應該在仔細討論後再做出。

bill.en: The electricity bill was higher than usual this month.
bill.zh: 這個月的電費帳單比平常高。

billion.en: The company invested nearly one billion dollars in new technology.
billion.zh: 這家公司在新科技上投資了將近十億元。

biology.en: Biology helps students understand how living things function and interact.
biology.zh: 生物學幫助學生了解生物如何運作與互動。

bird.en: A small bird built its nest near our classroom window.
bird.zh: 一隻小鳥在教室窗邊築巢。

birth.en: The hospital recorded a rise in birth rates last year.
birth.zh: 這家醫院記錄到去年出生率上升。

birthday.en: We prepared a small birthday surprise for our classmate.
birthday.zh: 我們為同學準備了一個小小的生日驚喜。

biscuit.en: She ate a biscuit with tea during the afternoon break.
biscuit.zh: 下午休息時，她配茶吃了一塊餅乾。

bit.en: The task became a bit easier after we read the example.
bit.zh: 看過範例後，這項任務變得容易了一點。

bite.en: Be careful because some insects may bite when disturbed.
bite.zh: 要小心，有些昆蟲受到干擾時可能會咬人。

bitter.en: The medicine tasted bitter, but it helped reduce the pain.
bitter.zh: 這藥味道很苦，但有助於減輕疼痛。

black.en: The teacher wrote the answer on the black board with chalk.
black.zh: 老師用粉筆把答案寫在黑色板面上。

blade.en: The machine stops automatically if the blade becomes blocked.
blade.zh: 如果刀片被卡住，機器會自動停止。

blame.en: It is not helpful to blame others without understanding the situation.
blame.zh: 不了解情況就責怪別人並沒有幫助。

blank.en: Leave the space blank if the question does not apply to you.
blank.zh: 如果問題不適用於你，請將該欄留白。

blanket.en: We brought a blanket to sit on during the picnic.
blanket.zh: 野餐時我們帶了一條毯子坐。

blind.en: The organization provides reading tools for blind students.
blind.zh: 這個組織為視障學生提供閱讀工具。

block.en: A fallen tree blocked the road after the storm.
block.zh: 暴風雨後，一棵倒下的樹擋住道路。

blood.en: The doctor ordered a blood test to check his health.
blood.zh: 醫師安排驗血以檢查他的健康狀況。

blow.en: Strong winds can blow loose objects across the street.
blow.zh: 強風可能把鬆動的物品吹到街上。

blue.en: The sky turned deep blue after the clouds disappeared.
blue.zh: 雲散去後，天空變成深藍色。

board.en: The teacher drew a simple diagram on the board.
board.zh: 老師在板上畫了一個簡單圖示。

boat.en: The small boat crossed the lake before sunset.
boat.zh: 那艘小船在日落前穿過湖面。

body.en: The human body needs enough sleep to recover properly.
body.zh: 人體需要充足睡眠才能好好恢復。

boil.en: Please boil the water before using it for the experiment.
boil.zh: 實驗使用這些水之前請先煮沸。

bone.en: Calcium is important for keeping each bone strong and healthy.
bone.zh: 鈣對維持每根骨頭強健很重要。

book.en: I borrowed a book about climate change from the library.
book.zh: 我從圖書館借了一本關於氣候變遷的書。

border.en: The river forms part of the border between the two regions.
border.zh: 這條河構成兩個地區之間部分邊界。

boring.en: The lecture was not boring because the speaker used many examples.
boring.zh: 這場演講並不無聊，因為講者用了很多例子。

born.en: She was born in Taiwan but grew up overseas.
born.zh: 她出生在台灣，但在海外長大。

borrow.en: Students may borrow up to five books at one time.
borrow.zh: 學生一次最多可以借五本書。

boss.en: The boss asked the team to finish the report by Friday.
boss.zh: 主管要求團隊在星期五前完成報告。

both.en: Both solutions are possible, but one is much more efficient.
both.zh: 兩種解法都可行，但其中一種有效率得多。

bother.en: Please do not bother other students while they are studying.
bother.zh: 其他學生讀書時請不要打擾他們。

bottle.en: Remember to bring a reusable bottle to reduce plastic waste.
bottle.zh: 記得攜帶可重複使用的水瓶，以減少塑膠垃圾。

bottom.en: The answer key is printed at the bottom of the page.

bowl.en: She poured the soup into a large bowl.
bowl.zh: 她把湯倒進一個大碗裡。

box.en: Please place the completed forms inside this box.
box.zh: 請把填好的表格放進這個箱子裡。

boy.en: The boy raised his hand to answer the teacher's question.
boy.zh: 那個男孩舉手回答老師的問題。

brain.en: Regular sleep helps the brain process and store new information.
brain.zh: 規律睡眠有助於大腦處理和儲存新資訊。

branch.en: A bird was resting on a branch above the path.
branch.zh: 一隻鳥停在小徑上方的樹枝上。

brand.en: The company introduced a new brand aimed at younger customers.
brand.zh: 這家公司推出了一個針對年輕顧客的新品牌。

brave.en: It was brave of her to speak honestly about the problem.
brave.zh: 她勇敢地誠實談論這個問題。

bread.en: He bought fresh bread from the bakery before breakfast.
bread.zh: 早餐前他從麵包店買了新鮮麵包。

break.en: Remember to take a short break after studying for an hour.
break.zh: 讀書一小時後記得休息一下。

breakfast.en: A healthy breakfast can help students concentrate during morning classes.
breakfast.zh: 健康的早餐有助於學生在上午課堂保持專注。

breathe.en: Try to breathe slowly when you begin to feel nervous.
breathe.zh: 開始感到緊張時，試著慢慢呼吸。

breath.en: She took a deep breath before starting her presentation.
breath.zh: 開始報告前，她深吸了一口氣。

bridge.en: The new bridge reduced travel time between the two towns.
bridge.zh: 新橋縮短了兩個城鎮之間的交通時間。

brief.en: The teacher gave a brief explanation before the group activity.
brief.zh: 小組活動前，老師做了簡短說明。

bright.en: The room felt brighter after we opened the curtains.
bright.zh: 我們拉開窗簾後，房間感覺更明亮。

bring.en: Please bring your notebook and calculator to tomorrow's class.
bring.zh: 明天上課請帶筆記本和計算機。

broad.en: The survey covered a broad range of student opinions.
broad.zh: 這份調查涵蓋了廣泛的學生意見。

broadcast.en: The station will broadcast the final match live tonight.
broadcast.zh: 這家電台今晚將現場轉播決賽。

brother.en: My brother helped me practice for the English speaking test.
brother.zh: 我哥哥幫我練習英文口說測驗。

brown.en: The leaves turned brown after several weeks without rain.
brown.zh: 好幾週沒下雨後，葉子變成褐色。

brush.en: Remember to brush your teeth before going to bed.

build.en: The class worked together to build a simple model bridge.
build.zh: 全班合作製作了一座簡單的橋梁模型。

building.en: The new building has larger classrooms and better ventilation.
building.zh: 新建築有更大的教室和更好的通風。

burn.en: Dry leaves can burn quickly in hot and windy weather.
burn.zh: 乾燥樹葉在炎熱有風的天氣中很容易燃燒。

bus.en: We took the bus because the train service was delayed.
bus.zh: 因為火車延誤，我們改搭公車。

business.en: The class studied how a small business manages its costs.
business.zh: 全班研究小型企業如何管理成本。

busy.en: The library becomes especially busy during the week before exams.
busy.zh: 考試前一週圖書館會特別忙碌。

but.en: The plan sounded simple, but it required careful preparation.
but.zh: 這個計畫聽起來簡單，但需要仔細準備。

button.en: Press the green button to save your changes.
button.zh: 按下綠色按鈕以儲存變更。

buy.en: We decided to buy the cheaper model after comparing the features.
buy.zh: 比較功能後，我們決定購買較便宜的型號。

by.en: Please finish the assignment by Friday afternoon.
by.zh: 請在星期五下午前完成作業。

cabbage.en: The farmer grows cabbage and other vegetables during the cool season.
cabbage.zh: 農夫在涼爽季節種植高麗菜和其他蔬菜。

cage.en: The injured bird rested in a cage until it recovered.
cage.zh: 受傷的小鳥在籠子裡休養直到康復。

cake.en: She baked a chocolate cake for her friend's birthday.
cake.zh: 她為朋友生日烤了一個巧克力蛋糕。

calculate.en: Students learned to calculate the average using the survey results.
calculate.zh: 學生學會用調查結果計算平均值。

calendar.en: I wrote the exam date on my calendar so I would not forget.
calendar.zh: 我把考試日期寫在行事曆上，以免忘記。

call.en: Please call the office if you cannot attend the meeting.
call.zh: 如果你無法參加會議，請打電話到辦公室。

calm.en: She stayed calm even when the computer suddenly stopped working.
calm.zh: 即使電腦突然停止運作，她仍保持冷靜。

camera.en: The camera captured clear images of the night sky.
camera.zh: 這台相機拍下了清晰的夜空影像。

camp.en: The students stayed at a science camp during summer vacation.
camp.zh: 學生暑假期間參加了科學營。

campaign.en: The school started a campaign to reduce single-use plastic.
campaign.zh: 學校發起了一項減少一次性塑膠的活動。

campus.en: Visitors must wear identification while walking around the campus.
campus.zh: 訪客在校園內活動時必須佩戴識別證。

can.en: Regular practice can make difficult vocabulary easier to remember.
can.zh: 規律練習可以讓困難單字更容易記住。

cancel.en: The school may cancel the event if the storm becomes stronger.
cancel.zh: 如果暴風雨變強，學校可能取消活動。

cancer.en: The article explains how early screening can help detect cancer.
cancer.zh: 這篇文章說明早期篩檢如何幫助發現癌症。

candidate.en: Each candidate gave a short speech before the class election.
candidate.zh: 每位候選人在班級選舉前都發表了簡短演說。

capital.en: Taipei is the capital of Taiwan and an important transportation center.
capital.zh: 台北是台灣的首都，也是重要的交通中心。

captain.en: The captain encouraged the team after they lost the first game.
captain.zh: 球隊輸掉第一場比賽後，隊長鼓勵了大家。

capture.en: The photographer tried to capture the changing colors of the sunset.
capture.zh: 攝影師試著捕捉夕陽不斷變化的色彩。

car.en: We left the car at home and took the train instead.
car.zh: 我們把車留在家裡，改搭火車。

card.en: Each student received a card with a different discussion question.
card.zh: 每位學生都拿到一張寫有不同討論題目的卡片。

care.en: Students should take care when handling glass equipment in the laboratory.
care.zh: 學生在實驗室操作玻璃器材時應小心。

career.en: She is considering a career in medicine or public health.
career.zh: 她正在考慮從事醫學或公共衛生相關工作。

careful.en: Be careful when entering data because small mistakes can affect results.
careful.zh: 輸入資料時要小心，因為小錯誤可能影響結果。

carefully.en: Read the instructions carefully before answering the questions.
carefully.zh: 回答問題前請仔細閱讀說明。

carry.en: This backpack can carry a laptop and several heavy books.
carry.zh: 這個背包可以裝一台筆電和好幾本厚書。

case.en: In this case, waiting for more information is the safest choice.
case.zh: 在這種情況下，等待更多資訊是最安全的選擇。

cash.en: The small shop accepts both cash and electronic payments.
cash.zh: 這家小店同時接受現金和電子支付。

cat.en: The cat slept quietly under the chair during the afternoon.
cat.zh: 那隻貓下午安靜地睡在椅子下。

catch.en: We ran to catch the last bus home.
catch.zh: 我們跑去趕最後一班回家的公車。

category.en: Each book is placed in a category based on its subject.
category.zh: 每本書都依主題被歸入一個類別。

cause.en: Lack of sleep can cause problems with concentration and memory.
cause.zh: 睡眠不足可能造成專注力和記憶方面的問題。

ceiling.en: A small fan was installed in the ceiling above the desk.
ceiling.zh: 書桌上方的天花板裝了一台小風扇。

celebrate.en: The class will celebrate the end of the semester with a small party.
celebrate.zh: 全班會用一個小聚會慶祝學期結束。

celebration.en: The graduation celebration included music, speeches, and student performances.
celebration.zh: 畢業慶祝活動包含音樂、演說和學生表演。

center.en: The community center offers free study space on weekends.
center.zh: 社區中心週末提供免費自習空間。

central.en: The station is located in the central part of the city.
central.zh: 車站位於城市中心地區。

century.en: The building was constructed near the end of the nineteenth century.
century.zh: 這棟建築建於十九世紀末期。

ceremony.en: The award ceremony will begin immediately after the final performance.
ceremony.zh: 頒獎典禮會在最後一場表演後立刻開始。

certain.en: We need to be certain that the data is accurate before publishing it.
certain.zh: 發布資料前，我們必須確定資料正確。

certainly.en: Regular practice will certainly improve your confidence over time.
certainly.zh: 規律練習肯定會逐漸提升你的自信。

chair.en: Please move your chair closer to the table before we begin.
chair.zh: 開始前請把椅子移近桌子。

chairman.en: The chairman opened the meeting with a brief introduction.
chairman.zh: 主席用簡短介紹為會議揭開序幕。

challenge.en: Learning to speak confidently is a challenge for many students.
challenge.zh: 學會有自信地說話對許多學生來說是一項挑戰。

chance.en: This program gives students a chance to practice speaking English.
chance.zh: 這項計畫讓學生有機會練習說英文。

change.en: A small change in routine can sometimes improve study efficiency.
change.zh: 日常作息的小改變有時能提升讀書效率。

channel.en: The school uses an online channel to share important announcements.
channel.zh: 學校使用線上頻道發布重要公告。

chapter.en: Please read the next chapter before Wednesday's discussion.
chapter.zh: 請在星期三討論前讀完下一章。

character.en: The main character changes greatly during the course of the story.
character.zh: 故事中的主角在情節發展過程中有很大的改變。

charge.en: The hotel does not charge students for using the study room.
charge.zh: 這家旅館不向學生收取使用自習室的費用。

chart.en: The chart shows how student performance changed over three years.
chart.zh: 這張圖表顯示學生表現三年來的變化。

cheap.en: The cheapest option is not always the best choice.
cheap.zh: 最便宜的選項不一定總是最好的選擇。

check.en: Please check your answers before submitting the online form.
check.zh: 提交線上表單前請檢查答案。

cheer.en: The crowd began to cheer when the team scored.
cheer.zh: 球隊得分時，人群開始歡呼。

chemical.en: Students must wear gloves when handling this chemical in class.
chemical.zh: 學生在課堂上處理這種化學物質時必須戴手套。

chemistry.en: Chemistry helps explain how different substances react with each other.
chemistry.zh: 化學幫助我們了解不同物質如何彼此反應。

chicken.en: The restaurant serves grilled chicken with rice and vegetables.
chicken.zh: 這家餐廳供應烤雞配飯和蔬菜。

child.en: Every child needs enough sleep for healthy growth and learning.
child.zh: 每個孩子都需要充足睡眠，以維持健康成長與學習。

choice.en: You have a choice between taking the bus or walking.
choice.zh: 你可以選擇搭公車或走路。

choose.en: Please choose the answer that best matches the passage.
choose.zh: 請選擇最符合文章內容的答案。

church.en: The old church has stood in the town for over a century.
church.zh: 這座老教堂已在鎮上矗立超過一個世紀。

circle.en: Draw a circle around the correct answer on the worksheet.
circle.zh: 請在學習單上的正確答案外畫一個圓圈。

citizen.en: Every citizen has a role in keeping the community clean.
citizen.zh: 每位公民都有責任協助維持社區整潔。
